hero.title: aoXiv
hero.description: A comprehensive archive of astronomy and astrophysics olympiads. Ranging from the prestigious IOAA to national competitions like INAO and USAAAO, aoXiv provides official/translated problem statements, solutions, answer sheets, and grading schemes you rarely find elsewhere.

seo.homeDescription: An archive of problems and solutions from various astronomy and astrophysics olympiads. Includes IOAA, INAO, OAC, and many more international, regional, and national competitions.
seo.homeKeywords: problems, solutions, olympiad, astronomy, astrophysics, ioaa, inao, oac
